80: ## 2. 权限检测语义（必须真正生效，可验证）
81: 
82: - bucket_for_action(action)：`screen.*|screenshot|ui_script|ui.*` → screen_view；`input.*` → remote_input；`file_*|fs.*` → file_transfer；`clipboard.*` → clipboard；`exec_command|shell.*` → shell；`power.*` → power；`notify.*|app.*` → notifications；未知 → shell。
83: - ConsoleState::check_permission(device_id, action) -> PermissionCheck
84:   - 取该设备 peer 策略：Deny → allowed=false；Ask → allowed=false + requires_approval=true；Allow → allowed=true。
85:   - enforced_by = "controller-policy"；reason 用中文（如「策略为『询问』：每次执行前需要确认」）。
86: - ConsoleState::gate_action(device_id, action) -> Result<PermissionCheck, String>
87:   - Allow → Ok(check)
88:   - Deny → Err("权限未授予：<桶中文名>（策略：禁止）") + 写 INTERCEPTED 审计（error 说明权限拦截）
89:   - Ask → 创建/复用 ApprovalRequest，Err("需要授权：已发送确认请求（<ttl> 秒内有效）")
90: - approve_request(id, scope)：scope = once | session | always。once 只放行一次；session 记内存授权直到断开；always 写回 peer 策略并落盘。均写 SUCCESS 审计（action_type=permission.approve）。
91: - deny_request(id) → status=denied + INTERCEPTED 审计。
92: - list_approvals() → 仅 pending 且未过期；过期自动 expired。
93: - apply_preset(device_id, preset_id) → 写入预设权限并落盘。
94: - devices() -> Vec<DeviceDetail>：peers + connections 合成；granted_count = 7 桶中 level != Deny 的数量；preset 反向匹配（与预设完全一致则返回其 id，否则 custom）。
95: - connect_device(device_id)：demo 模式创建 Connection（role=controller，state=connected，connected_at=now，transport=wss，延迟 20-80ms）+ 写 session.start 审计；非 demo 返回 Err("控制台未接入 Hub：请用 teleagent hub 启动后从桌面端发起连接")。
96: - disconnect_device(device_id)：关闭链路 close_connection(id, EndReason::Normal) + 写 session.end 审计；不在线返回 Err("设备不在线")。

113: 
114: | id | 名称 | 说明 | 权限 |
115: |---|---|---|---|
116: | view_only | 仅查看 | 只能看屏幕 | screen_view=allow，其余 deny |
117: | standard | 标准控制 | 看屏 + 输入 + 剪贴板，文件询问，命令/电源禁止 | screen_view/remote_input/clipboard/notifications=allow，file_transfer=ask，shell/power=deny |
118: | full | 完全控制 | 除电源需确认外全允许 | power=ask，其余 allow |

120: 
121: ## 5. 系统权限对照（os_capabilities() 固定数据，4 系统 × 7 桶）
122: 
123: - macOS：screen_view → 「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 屏幕录制」/ TCC + ScreenCaptureKit / native；remote_input → 「辅助功能」/ AXUIElement + CGEvent / native；file_transfer → 「完全磁盘访问（可选）」；clipboard → 无需授权；shell → 无需授权（受黑名单约束）；power → 无需授权；notifications → 「通知 › TeleAgent」。
124: - Windows：screen_view → 无需系统授权（非安全桌面）/ DXGI Desktop Duplication / native；remote_input → 「UIAccess 或管理员（提升窗口）」/ SendInput + UIA / native；file_transfer → 文件系统 ACL；clipboard → 无需；shell → 无需（黑名单）；power → 无需；notifications → 「设置 › 系统 › 通知」。
125: - Linux：screen_view → Wayland 需 xdg-desktop-portal(PipeWire)，X11 无需 / requires_helper；remote_input → uinput/XTEST 权限 / requires_helper；file_transfer → 文件权限；clipboard → 无需；shell → 无需；power → logind/polkit；notifications → 无需。
126: - Android：screen_view → 「媒体投影（每次连接弹窗）」/ MediaProjection / native；remote_input → 「无障碍服务」或 Shizuku / native；file_transfer → 存储访问框架 / 全部文件访问；clipboard → Android 10+ 仅前台可读；shell → Shizuku(ADB shell)；power → 设备管理器；notifications → 「通知使用权」。
127: 
128: ## 6. 前端依赖判定
129: 
130: - 设备页用 GET /api/devices；离线显示「连接」，在线显示「断开 / 详情 / 删除」。
131: - 顶部横幅与角标用 approvals；批准/拒绝后刷新 state。
132: - 「一键授权」用 presets + POST preset。
133: - 「各系统权限差异」用 os_capabilities 渲染表格。

1. **路径本身公开可行**：loopback 回调 + PKCE + 授权码换 refresh_token，有**两个相互独立**的公开项目在做，且都跑通（含 loadCodeAssist 拿 project）。

### 判据 7（[官方] 设备码为何不可用 —— 客户端类型规则，非 Antigravity 特有）

### 判据 8（[官方] redirect_uri 规则 —— loopback 是否允许 http://localhost:<port>/oauth-callback）

Google 官方 OAuth 2.0 for Desktop Apps：

> The main difference is that desktop apps must open the system browser and **supply a local redirect URI (such as a loopback IP address)** to handle responses from Google's authorization server.
>
> Select the **Desktop app** application type. … **Desktop apps are public clients and cannot keep secrets confidential. Always use PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange)** when requesting authorization codes.

出处：<https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/native-app>

> **[推断]（有官方依据）**：
> - 若目标是 **Desktop 类型** client → loopback + 任意端口 + PKCE 是**官方支持**的形态，http://localhost:<port>/oauth-callback 可用。
> - 若目标是 **Web 类型** client → redirect_uri 必须与 Console 中**登记值精确匹配**，因此只有登记过的那一个 URI/端口可用（公开项目一律硬编码 51121，与此一致）。
> - **因此「redirect_uri 是否允许 http://localhost:<port>/oauth-callback」的答案取决于该 client 的类型与登记项**，而非全局规则。

### [推断] 自建 client 能否拿到 Code Assist 个人档资格

#167 自己也标注为风险（「风险：新客户端很可能同样拿不到 … 资格（资格是按 client 白名单发的），这条建议先拿测试账号验证再动手」）。

- **[推断] 更现实的门槛在 scope**：公开项目请求了 …/auth/cclog 与 …/auth/experimentsandconfigs。这两枚在旧 Gemini CLI client 上导致 403 restricted_client（#167 已实测）。Google 对受限/敏感 scope 有审核流程（官方 Web/Desktop 文档均提示 unverified app 与 verification process）。**自建 client 若要请求这两个 scope，很可能需要走 Google 的 OAuth 应用验证**，这与「client 白名单」是两件事。**该点属推断，未获官方文档直接支持。**

### 核对 #167 的「API key 方案不成立」

#167 原文：*「Gemini Code Assist for individuals 已经没有可用的 AI Studio 直连路径（个人号只能走 Code Assist 的 Cloud Code 端点，而那边的准入是按 client 身份发的）」*

### 「OmniRoute 等项目有没有因此被处理的公开记录？」

**无公开依据（针对「OmniRoute 本身被行动」这一点）。** 本次检索到：
- OmniRoute 仓库/wiki/onboarding 文档公开存在（<https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute>、<https://github.com/diegosouzapw/OmniRoute/wiki/Antigravity-Onboarding>），未见其仓库被下架、作者被追责、或用户因「使用 OmniRoute」被单独处理的公开记录。
- 检索到的封号记录均以「使用三方工具/OAuth 复用」这一**类别**为对象（判据 14/15），**未指向特定项目名**。
- 因此：**「因使用某个具体项目而被处理的公开记录」——无公开依据。**「该类行为已被官方定性为违约并存在批量执法」——**成立**（判据 11–14）。

### B4 逐项定性

| 行为 | 定性 | 判据层级 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 把用户本机 agy 的 token 导入第三方工具 | **违反** Antigravity Additional ToS 与 Gemini CLI 条款（“using third party software … to access the Service … is a breach”） | [官方] 判据 11/12/13 |
| 在 refresh 时复用 agy 的 client_id | 同上；且属于「third-party software … 使用 Antigravity 身份访问上游」的典型形态 | [官方] 判据 11/12/13 |
| 把 agy 作为子进程包装进第三方 agent | 官方 FAQ **明确**「not supported under consumer plans」 | [官方] 判据 12 |
| 实际后果 | 首次违规：通知 + 自我认证复议 → 自动解封；**二次违规：永久封禁**；封禁会**连带封锁 Gemini CLI 与 Code Assist** | [官方] 判据 14 |

## B5) 若身份面不可做，WildWork 的最小可行产品路线是什么？

**结论：建议不做身份面（第 3 步不做），MVP 走「官方认可路线 + 不动身份」。** 理由：身份面三项改动（token 导入 / 信封改造 / client 切换与 UA 伪造）**全部**落在判据 11–13 的禁止面内，且已有判据 14 的批量执法与永久封记录；而官方同时提供了明文推荐、无合规风险的替代路径。

### 推荐路线（按优先级）

**R1（首选，最高性价比）：不动身份面，只做「官方认可路线 + 可读错误」**
- 个人档：引导使用 **AI Studio (GEMINI_API_KEY) / Vertex AI** —— Google 在 Gemini CLI FAQ 与 Antigravity FAQ 里**明文推荐给三方 agent**（判据 9）。这与 issue #167 落地版 v2.9.3 已做的「错误文案可行动化」方向一致，是低风险延续。
- 企业/Vertex 档：保留现有 OAuth 路径 —— 官方原文「your access remains unchanged」（判据 1）。
- 增加 loadCodeAssist 预检，按 currentTier 提前给出可读错误（#167 第一条建议中**无需触碰身份面**的那部分）。
- 合规面：渠道文档需删除/修正任何「装 CLI 就能用」的暗示。

**R2：把 agy 当「用户自行操作的外部工具」，不做自动适配器**
- 若确有用户诉求，只做**纯文档指引**：「本渠道个人档请自行使用 Antigravity 官方 CLI」。**不**在 WildWork 内启动 agy 子进程、不导入 token、不代管刷新 —— 因为官方 FAQ 明确「wrapping agy inside third-party coding agents … is not supported under consumer plans」（判据 12）。
- 这比 #167 的「headless 适配器」方案更保守，但**符合官方口径**。

**R3（若 lead 决定承担合规风险）：只做「显式、手动、一次性导入」，且必须显著免责**
若最终仍要推进 agy 通道，据公开资料应满足的最小约束：
- **手动、显式导入**，无自动扫描、无自动轮询；
- **不自建 refresh**（refresh 交给 agy；失效即提示用户重新登录后重导）；
- 全链路显著位置标注：此路径**违反** Antigravity ToS，可能导致账号被**永久封禁且连带 Gemini CLI/Code Assist**（判据 11–14）；
- 建议**默认关闭**、需用户二次确认开启。
- **注意**：即使做到以上全部，据判据 11–13 **仍属违约**——这是「降低暴露面」而非「合规化」，lead 需明确接受该定性。

### 明确不建议的做法

| 做法 | 不建议理由 |
| --- | --- |
| 复用 agy 的 client_id 做 refresh（#167 第 2/3 步） | 判据 11–13 禁止；判据 14 有永久封机制 |
| 伪造 antigravity/… UA / Client-Metadata（#167 第 3 步） | 属「misrepresent identity / 使用三方软件访问 Antigravity」，同一禁止面 |
| 自建 client 做 loopback 授权码登录以「正名」 | 路径机制可行（判据 4/5/8），但**资格与受限 scope 未验证**，且**不解决**「个人档 Code Assist 已停用」这一根本问题（判据 1/2）——属于「换一枚 client 继续撞同一堵墙」，投入产出比最差 |

164: **官方**：

167: - `Snapshot.current` 与 `Snapshot.counts/last` 之外，前端 "Token 统计" 卡用的是 `current` + `generatedReasoning/AnswerTokens/CallTokens`（`:1456-1472, 2056-2061`）

169: **我们的实现**：
170: - `daemon.mjs:1634-1643`：8 个分类的 `percent` 直接写死 `0.6 / 1.0 / 0.1 / 0.7 / 1.1 / 52.8 / 40.8 / 2.8`，tokens 由 `totalUsage * 常量` 得到

172: - `daemon.mjs:1429-1431`：`totalInputTokens = meta?.msg_use?.input || peakTokens`、`totalOutputTokens = … || 1200`、`totalCacheRead = … || 0`

180: case 'assistant/message': {
181:   const u = ev.data?.usage;
182:   if (u) {

186:     usage.output    += num(u.outputTokens);
187:     usage.calls     += 1;
188:     requests.push({ seq: ev.seq, time: ev.time, turn: ev.data.turn, step: ev.data.step,
189:                     prompt: num(u.inputTokens)+num(u.cacheReadTokens)+num(u.cacheWriteTokens),
190:                     output: num(u.outputTokens) });

195: totalOutputTokens = usage.output;        // 64609
196: totalCacheRead    = usage.cacheRead;     // 8999424
197: cacheHitRate      = (usage.cacheRead / (usage.uncached + usage.cacheRead) * 100).toFixed(2); // 97.57

248: **官方**（`off-index.pretty.mjs`）：
249: - 工具→类别映射：`{read, read_image:'read', write:'write', edit:'write', grep:'search', glob:'search'}`（`:238-240`），`str_replace_editor` 按 `command==='view'` 判读/写（`:243-244`）
250: - 路径优先级：`grep/glob` → `path` 否则 `pattern`；其余 `file_path → filePath → path`（`:249-259`）
251: - 行数：`Ve(s)` = 换行符计数（结尾有 `\n` 不 +1）（`:260-268`），`He(new,old)` 分别算 added/removed（`:269-282`）

253: - 搜索：按结果 `meta.files[].matches.length` **展开成每个命中文件一条**，带 `hits`，另加一条 `pattern:true` 的查询记录（`:299-364`）
254: - 嵌套（code mode）：`tool/ptc-dispatch` 产出的 ops 先入 `pendingCodeOps`，在 `tool/result` 时补 `parent` 落地（`:1848-1856, 1981-1994`）

256: **我们的实现**：
257: - 抽取：`daemon.mjs:276-511`（`extractFileOpsFromToolCall`）——**没有 `run_code` 分支**，也没有 `read_image`；`tool/call` 只认顶层（`parseDshSession:1267-1280` 只把 `tool/result` 与顶层 call 关联）

261: **实测**：真实 46 次文件操作（read 22 / write 19 / search 5，25 个文件，含 3 次 `read_image`），magpie `fileOps = []`。

271:           : (args.file_path || args.filePath || args.path);

276:   return [{ seq, time, kind, tool:name, path:p, err:!!err, added, removed, parent }];

1	# Console API v3 — 双向默认 / 被控授权检测
2	
3	在 v2 基础上的增量。
4	
5	## 1. 语义变更
6	
7	- 默认双向控制：每台新配对设备默认既能控制本机、也能被本机控制。PermissionSet::default() 改为：
8	  screen_view=allow, remote_input=allow, file_transfer=allow, clipboard=allow, notifications=allow, shell=ask, power=deny。
9	- 分设备权限 = 被控权限：ConsoleState::set_peer_permissions 存的仍是每设备 PermissionSet，
10	  但语义明确为「该设备可以如何控制本机」。UI 文案统一改成「XX 对本机的被控权限」。
11	- 删除单设备操作检测：不再在 UI 展示 GET /api/permissions/check 按钮（接口保留兼容）。
12	- 总开关：Settings.allow_being_controlled: bool（默认 true）。false 时任何设备都不能控制本机。
13	- 系统级授权检测：新增总览接口，返回本机 OS 上「被控制」所需的系统权限是否真正授权。
14	
15	## 2. 新增模型（src/console/model.rs）
16	
17	```rust
18	pub struct SystemPermission {
19	    pub key: String,        // accessibility | screen_recording | filesystem | notifications | shizuku | uiaccess
20	    pub label: String,
21	    pub status: String,     // "granted" | "denied" | "unknown"
22	    pub detail: String,     // 系统设置路径或说明
23	}
24	
25	pub struct SystemPermissionStatus {
26	    pub os: String,             // macos | windows | linux | android | unknown
27	    pub label: String,
28	    pub allow_being_controlled: bool,
29	    pub can_be_controlled: bool,
30	    pub items: Vec<SystemPermission>,
31	    pub summary: String,
32	    pub checked_at: DateTime<Utc>,
33	}
34	```
35	
36	ConsoleSnapshot 追加 system_permissions: SystemPermissionStatus。
37	Settings 追加 allow_being_controlled: bool（默认 true）；SettingsPatch 追加 Option<bool>。
38	
39	## 3. 系统授权检测（src/console/system.rs 新文件）
40	
41	pub fn detect() -> SystemPermissionStatus：
42	- macOS：extern C 链接 ApplicationServices framework 调 AXIsProcessTrusted() 判定「辅助功能」；
43	  「屏幕录制」无法可靠自动判定 → status=unknown，detail=系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 屏幕录制；
44	  「完全磁盘访问」「通知」同样 unknown + 设置路径。
45	- Windows：「UIAccess/管理员」「非安全桌面截屏」「通知」全部 unknown + 具体设置路径，status 不写 denied。
46	- Linux：「Wayland 门户(PipeWire)」「XTEST/uinput」「polkit」unknown + 说明。
47	- Android：「无障碍服务」「媒体投影」「Shizuku」「通知使用权」unknown + 说明。
48	- can_be_controlled = allow_being_controlled && 没有任何 item.status == "denied"。
49	- summary：无 denied →「未发现明确拒绝项；带『待确认』的项目请到系统设置核对」；
50	  有 denied →「辅助功能未授权，本机暂不能被远程输入控制；请到 系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 辅助功能 开启」。
51	- ConsoleState::system_permissions() -> SystemPermissionStatus：读设置总开关后调 detect()。
52	
53	## 4. 路由
54	
55	| 方法 | 路径 | 返回 |
56	|---|---|---|
57	| GET | /api/permissions/system | SystemPermissionStatus |
58	
59	PATCH /api/settings 支持 {"allow_being_controlled":false}。
60	
61	## 5. Tauri 命令
62	
63	console_system_permissions() -> SystemPermissionStatus（总数 28 条命令）。
64	
65	## 6. 前端契约

80	## 2. 权限检测语义（必须真正生效，可验证）
81	
82	- bucket_for_action(action)：`screen.*|screenshot|ui_script|ui.*` → screen_view；`input.*` → remote_input；`file_*|fs.*` → file_transfer；`clipboard.*` → clipboard；`exec_command|shell.*` → shell；`power.*` → power；`notify.*|app.*` → notifications；未知 → shell。
83	- ConsoleState::check_permission(device_id, action) -> PermissionCheck
84	  - 取该设备 peer 策略：Deny → allowed=false；Ask → allowed=false + requires_approval=true；Allow → allowed=true。
85	  - enforced_by = "controller-policy"；reason 用中文（如「策略为『询问』：每次执行前需要确认」）。
86	- ConsoleState::gate_action(device_id, action) -> Result<PermissionCheck, String>
87	  - Allow → Ok(check)
88	  - Deny → Err("权限未授予：<桶中文名>（策略：禁止）") + 写 INTERCEPTED 审计（error 说明权限拦截）
89	  - Ask → 创建/复用 ApprovalRequest，Err("需要授权：已发送确认请求（<ttl> 秒内有效）")
90	- approve_request(id, scope)：scope = once | session | always。once 只放行一次；session 记内存授权直到断开；always 写回 peer 策略并落盘。均写 SUCCESS 审计（action_type=permission.approve）。
91	- deny_request(id) → status=denied + INTERCEPTED 审计。
92	- list_approvals() → 仅 pending 且未过期；过期自动 expired。
93	- apply_preset(device_id, preset_id) → 写入预设权限并落盘。
94	- devices() -> Vec<DeviceDetail>：peers + connections 合成；granted_count = 7 桶中 level != Deny 的数量；preset 反向匹配（与预设完全一致则返回其 id，否则 custom）。
95	- connect_device(device_id)：demo 模式创建 Connection（role=controller，state=connected，connected_at=now，transport=wss，延迟 20-80ms）+ 写 session.start 审计；非 demo 返回 Err("控制台未接入 Hub：请用 teleagent hub 启动后从桌面端发起连接")。
96	- disconnect_device(device_id)：关闭链路 close_connection(id, EndReason::Normal) + 写 session.end 审计；不在线返回 Err("设备不在线")。

113	
114	| id | 名称 | 说明 | 权限 |
115	|---|---|---|---|
116	| view_only | 仅查看 | 只能看屏幕 | screen_view=allow，其余 deny |
117	| standard | 标准控制 | 看屏 + 输入 + 剪贴板，文件询问，命令/电源禁止 | screen_view/remote_input/clipboard/notifications=allow，file_transfer=ask，shell/power=deny |
118	| full | 完全控制 | 除电源需确认外全允许 | power=ask，其余 allow |
119	| custom | 自定义 | 逐项调整 | — |

121	## 5. 系统权限对照（os_capabilities() 固定数据，4 系统 × 7 桶）
122	
123	- macOS：screen_view → 「系统设置 › 隐私与安全性 › 屏幕录制」/ TCC + ScreenCaptureKit / native；remote_input → 「辅助功能」/ AXUIElement + CGEvent / native；file_transfer → 「完全磁盘访问（可选）」；clipboard → 无需授权；shell → 无需授权（受黑名单约束）；power → 无需授权；notifications → 「通知 › TeleAgent」。
124	- Windows：screen_view → 无需系统授权（非安全桌面）/ DXGI Desktop Duplication / native；remote_input → 「UIAccess 或管理员（提升窗口）」/ SendInput + UIA / native；file_transfer → 文件系统 ACL；clipboard → 无需；shell → 无需（黑名单）；power → 无需；notifications → 「设置 › 系统 › 通知」。
125	- Linux：screen_view → Wayland 需 xdg-desktop-portal(PipeWire)，X11 无需 / requires_helper；remote_input → uinput/XTEST 权限 / requires_helper；file_transfer → 文件权限；clipboard → 无需；shell → 无需；power → logind/polkit；notifications → 无需。
126	- Android：screen_view → 「媒体投影（每次连接弹窗）」/ MediaProjection / native；remote_input → 「无障碍服务」或 Shizuku / native；file_transfer → 存储访问框架 / 全部文件访问；clipboard → Android 10+ 仅前台可读；shell → Shizuku(ADB shell)；power → 设备管理器；notifications → 「通知使用权」。
127	
128	## 6. 前端依赖判定
129	
130	- 设备页用 GET /api/devices；离线显示「连接」，在线显示「断开 / 详情 / 删除」。
131	- 顶部横幅与角标用 approvals；批准/拒绝后刷新 state。
132	- 「一键授权」用 presets + POST preset。
133	- 「各系统权限差异」用 os_capabilities 渲染表格。

72	impl ConsoleState {
73	    pub fn new(opts: ConsoleOptions) -> Self {
74	        // Demo data lives in its own sandbox so real history is never touched.
75	        let base = opts.data_dir.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
76	            let home = store::home_dir();
77	            if opts.demo {
78	                home.join("demo")
79	            } else {
80	                home
81	            }
82	        });
83	
84	        let peers_path = base.join("trusted_peers.json");
85	        let peers = TrustedPeerStore::new(peers_path);
86	
87	        let audit_hub = JsonlStore::new(base.join("hub_audit.jsonl"));
88	        let audit_node = JsonlStore::new(base.join("node_audit.jsonl"));
89	        let sessions = JsonlStore::new(base.join("console_history.jsonl"));
90	        let perms = store::permissions_doc(base.join("console_permissions.json"));
91	
92	        let device_name = hostname::get()
93	            .ok()
94	            .and_then(|h| h.into_string().ok())
95	            .unwrap_or_else(|| "teleagent-console".into());
96	        let device_id = format!("console-{:x}", fxhash(&device_name));
97	
98	        let defaults = Settings {
99	            signaler_url: opts.signaler_url.clone(),
100	            device_name: device_name.clone(),
101	            theme: "dark".into(),
102	            language: "zh-CN".into(),
103	            notify_on_connect: true,
104	            notify_on_intercept: true,
105	            auto_approve_paired: false,
106	            security: SecuritySettings {
107	                blacklist_enabled: true,
108	                require_approval_for_shell: true,
109	                blocked_patterns: crate::protocol::SecurityConfig::default().deny_patterns,
110	            },
111	            mcp_config: serde_json::json!({
112	                "mcpServers": {
113	                    "teleagent": {
114	                        "command": "teleagent",
115	                        "args": ["hub", "--signaler", opts.signaler_url, "--stdio"]
116	                    }
117	                }
118	            }),
119	        };
120	        let settings = SettingsDoc::new(base.join("console_settings.json"), defaults);
121	
122	        let me = SelfInfo {
123	            device_id,
124	            device_name,
125	            os: format!("{} {}", std::env::consts::OS, std::env::consts::ARCH),
126	            arch: std::env::consts::ARCH.to_string(),
127	            mode: if opts.host == "desktop" { "hub".into() } else { "console".into() },
128	            inbound_permissions: perms.get().inbound,
129	        };
130	
131	        let signaler = SignalerStatus {
132	            url: opts.signaler_url.clone(),

=== cordis.patch.yml ===
# Your patch layer for this dsh profile, applied after every bundle layer:
# a top-level YAML array of loader patch entries (id-targeted config
# overrides, disables, and insert lists; `!!js` expressions allowed).

# Desktop control (Cua Driver) — the computer-use service plus its MCP provider.
# MCP form (not native): it talks to the separately-installed CuaDriver.app, which
# owns its own TCC grants AND can render the visible agent-cursor overlay.
# Only one computer-use provider may be active, so the native one stays disabled.
- insert:
    - id: computer-use
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-computer-use"
    - id: computer-use-cua-driver-mcp
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-mcp"
      config:
        command: /Applications/CuaDriver.app/Contents/MacOS/cua-driver
        args:
          - mcp
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    - id: computer-use-cua-driver-native
      name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-computer-use-cua-driver-native"
      disabled: true

  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-plugin-manager/tools"
  disabled: false

# ── Cloudflare Access → DSH browser session ────────────────────────────────
#
# Row ids come from the dsh-web-app bundle: the connection row is `connection`
# and the web-app row is `web-runtime` — NOT the package names. A patch replaces
# the targeted row's whole `config`, so the bundle's own !!js expressions are
# restated and the extra authorities are APPENDED to the LAN-derived list.
#
# trustedHosts lists the authority the BROWSER sends in the Host header, i.e.
# the public hostname. host.docker.internal is included so the cloudflared
# container can reach this server by that name while still passing the
# Host/Origin fence (such a request arrives as Host: host.docker.internal:19387,
# which is not loopback, so it must be declared). A port-less entry matches any
# port.
#
# cookieMaxAgeDays: the connection layer rejects any cookie whose issue/expiry
# interval exceeds its own configured maximum, so this value also caps what the
# cf-access-auth plugin below can mint.
- id: connection
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-connection

talling plugins directly from GitHub subpaths (with branch resolution).
- Fixed variable resolution in plugins, ensuring gemini cli variables like `${extensionPath}` correctly resolves to the final installation directory.
- Added native Wayland clipboard support (wl-paste) on Linux, falling back to `xclip` for X11 environments, and prioritized copied files (from file managers) over raw image data.
- Preserved unknown fields in `settings.json` during read, write, and merge operations, preventing settings from being silently wiped out when switching between different CLI versions or builds.
- Fixed layout boundary overflow, scrolling visibility, and out-of-bounds scrolling bugs in the artifact detail view when inline comments are present.
## 1.0.6
- Added shell-style path auto-completion for `/open` and `/add-dir`.
- Added optimistic rendering for user chat prompt submissions, injecting messages immediately into the viewport to eliminate perceived input lag.
--
- Fixed OAuth token persistence and authentication hangs.
- Fixed Windows log redirection and resizing issues. Resolved a critical bug where logs were not redirected correctly on Windows, which previously caused the terminal to swallow window resize events and shut down slowly.
- Added `proceed-in-sandbox` tool permission mode. Auto-approves terminal commands that run inside the secure sandbox, requesting manual approval only when a command attempts to bypass the sandbox.
- Integrates consumer/free-tier onboarding directly into the CLI.
- Added plugin discovery for skills and agents. Automatically scans installed plugin directories to make custom skills and specialized agents available for execution in the CLI.
- Fixed pasted text line counting. Corrected line counting for user inputs to ensure extremely long inputs are correctly folded into a `[Pasted text #X +Y lines]` placeholder to keep the viewport clean.
- Fixed onboarding stability. Resolved a race condition where a concurrent terminal resize event during onboarding could revert the UI to a blank onboarding screen.
- Moves the **terminal** color scheme to the top of the selection list, making it the default choice during onboarding and in `/settings`.
- Improved `/usage` and `/quota` commands. Forces a real-time reload of model configuration and remaining quotas, allowing you to see updated real-time consumption statistics immediately.
- Improved step rendering layout. Calculates available terminal width dynamically and uses middle-truncation (`/foo/.../bar`) for file path tools to prevent layout shifting on narrow screens.
- Improved session deletion keybinding in `/resume`. Changed the shortcut from `ctrl+d` to `ctrl+delete` to resolve conflicts with the global exit keybinding (`ctrl+d` `ctrl+d`) and preserve Emacs-style forward-delete in search input fields.
--

| R75 | **429 + code 14018「积分耗尽」必须归 `hard_credit`，且候选耗尽时可在请求内按降级链重入一次**（2026-10-17，PR #150） | **现象**（2026-09-23 起生产实录）：账号积分耗尽时上游返回 `429 + {"error":{"data":{"code":14018,"msg":"Credits exhausted…"}}}`，但两份 `Classify` 的 429 分支**无条件**返回 `ErrSoftRate`——`hardMarkers` 里配的是单数 `"credit exhausted"`，上游文案是复数 `"Credits exhausted"`（差一个 s，且 429 分支在 hardMarkers 之前直接 return ⇒ 永远漏匹配）；`14018` 也无任何特判。**后果链**：误判软限流 → 只冷「账号×模型」60s → 12h 账号级硬冷却从不触发 → **跨渠道降级链永不触发**（R54 的触发判据依赖账号级 hard 失败）→ 客户端在同一渠道死循环吃 429。**修法 A（分类）**：429 分支 return 前特判 `"code":14018`（**精确匹配**：命中后下一字符须非数字，防未来 `140180` 类新码误归 12h 账号硬冷却）或文案 `credits exhausted` → `ErrHardCredit`；`6004`/`14003`/`quota exceeded` 保持软限流不回归（单测断言）。**修法 B（请求内重入）**：触发条件全真——轮转耗尽 + 最后 `kind=hard_credit` + 非单账号渠道 + 尚未写过任何响应字节；此时按 `pickModelFallback` 切备胎**重入同一轮转段**（抽 `serveRotation` 方法使「重入 = 再次调用」，`tried` 随调用重建），客户端全程 200 无感，响应头 `X-Model-Fallback` 标注实际备胎。**重入封顶一次**（`fbAttempt==0`）：A→B→C 链式规则下不得从备胎再降备胎（有测试独立锁定——断言第三渠道零调用，删掉封顶即红）。**配套**：`statRow.Status` 清零（429 轮转已污染，出口靠 `Status==0` 记 200）；单账号渠道豁免（惩罚豁免不变量 22）。**与 R60 的关系**：R60 的「单号渠道 402 → 模型级冷却」保持不变，本条的请求内重入**不适用于**单账号渠道（透传是惩罚豁免的设计约束）。**回归**：`internal/server/model_fallback_14018_test.go`（7 例：A 组全链路分类→冷却→入口降级、B 组请求内 200 无感、链式规则封顶、单账号豁免、记账归备胎（非流式+流式）、`140180`→软限流精确匹配）+ 两包 `TestClassify` 矩阵扩展。**如实披露**：生产端到端未触发复验（上游配额在部署前已恢复，14018 场景消失），行为由单测锁定；生产 `Classify` 实为四份，本条覆盖 `workbuddyai`/`upstream` 两份（`oczen`/`monkeycode` 是渠道专用分类、429 恒软限流且不查 body，不加特判是正确的）。 |
| R76 | **登录态失效（401）必须走「可自愈的 SessionDead 标记」，不得 `pool.Disable` 永久禁用；且重登后标记必须自动清除**（2026-10-17，issue #134 / PR #139 + 合并期补修） | **问题**：旧版对 `ErrSessionDead` 走 `pool.Disable`，把**机器状态混进用户控制项**（「停用」是用户手动开关）——账号被禁用后面板看不出该做什么；更严重的是 `SyncToDir` 只替换 `e.a`，**禁用/标记不清除** ⇒ 用户重新登录、`RefreshToken` 也成功了，账号**永不被 `Pick()` 选中**，面板永远显示失效（正是 #134 报的现象）。**修法**：① `pool.Status` 新增 `session_dead` / `session_dead_reason`（与 `Disabled` 分离），`entry.healthy()` 对 `disabled || sessionDead` 都跳过；② 面板显示「需重新登录」徽标 + ⟳ 一键重新登录（仅对有登录编排的渠道，`RELOGIN_CHANNELS`）；③ 签到失败信息若为登录态形态，追加可操作指引；④ **401 统一归 `ErrSessionDead`**——原 `{"code":9999,"msg":"bad token"}` 这类被归 `ErrClient` 会走错惩罚路径（R75 的 `ErrClient` 不罚号语义在这里反而是漏判）。**合并期补的阻断性缺陷（本条核心）**：新增 `sessionDeadAt`（标记建立时间，`accountState` 持久化字段，只增不减、向后兼容），`SyncToDir` 末尾调 `clearReloggedLocked`——**auth 文件 mtime 晚于标记建立时间即视为已重登**，自动清除标记并落盘；`FilePath` 为空（内存构造凭证）无从判断，保守保留标记。**为什么不能只靠「下一次成功」清除**：已失效账号不会有成功请求，签到也会因 401 失败 ⇒ 只能靠「凭据文件被重写」这一外部事实判定。**与不变量 19/20 的关系**：`refreshIfSessionDead` 的「refresh + 落盘 + 重试一次」保持不变，本条补的是「重登后标记解除」这一环。**回归**：`internal/pool` 的 SessionDead 状态机用例、`internal/server/glm_rotation_test.go`（原断言 `Disabled` 改为 `SessionDead`，并新增「登录失效不得混入用户停用」断言）、`internal/server/cline_no_account_softening_test.go`（Key 失效改为标记而非禁用）。 |
| R77 | **上游显式声明可重试的 429（14003 瞬时拥塞）必须在请求内重试一次，不得直接抛错让上层罚号**（2026-10-17） | **现象**：workbuddyai 双账号在 18~48s 内相继撞 `429 code=14003`（瞬时拥塞），双双落入冷却轮换 → 无健康账号 → 客户端拿到 `503 no_healthy_account`。而上游响应本身明写「稍等重试即可」——故障本可自愈，是把罚号叠上去才放大成渠道级故障。**语义区分（两类 429 不得混治）**：14003 是**瞬时拥塞**（无重置时刻，上游给「可重试」信号）；6004 是**用量配额**（带 `usage will reset at X`，上游不给可重试信号——reset 前重试必失败）。对 6004 的正确处理仍是冷却到重置点（#82 已有），本条只开 14003 的口。**判据（结构化信号，永不取英文文案）**：响应体含 `retry_policy.retry=true`（2026-10-12 实测形态）**或** `actions` 数组含 `"RETRY"`（2026-10-17 上游改版形态，retry_policy 字段消失）任一即视为上游声明可重试；只有 `SWITCH_MODEL` 是「换模型」语义，不代表同请求可重发，不算。**修法**：`retryDecision` 单点判定（429+信号 → 可重试限流）；**收紧的独立预算** `rateLimitMaxAttempts=2`（只重试一次，不与 5xx 的 `retryMaxAttempts=3` 混用——429 频繁重试有风控风险，宁可少试不刷屏）；退避固定 `20s`（上游 displayTips 原文「等约一分钟」的折中，不把对话请求挂满一分钟）；重试仍失败才把最后一次 429 交回上层走正常冷却+轮换。**回归**：`retry_policy_test.go`——双形态判据（retry_policy / actions-RETRY）、`SWITCH_MODEL`-only 反例、缺信号 429（含 6004）不重试守门、端到端「429 声明可重试 → 重试后 200」、预算耗尽后原文回传。**已知限制**：`retry_policy`/`actions` 都是上游协议级承诺，仍可能再漂移——若上游返回既无信号又非 6004 的 429，会落回「罚号+轮换」老路径（app.log 可见）；届时按新形态补判据，仍不得退到英文文案匹配。 |
| R79 | **目录/费率接口遇 HTTP ≥400 必须返回类型化 `*provider.Error`，不得用裸 `fmt.Errorf`**（2026-10-18，排查 WorkBuddyCN 401 时发现） | **问题**：`upstream.FetchModels` / `upstream.FetchModelPricing` / `workbuddyai.fetchCatalog` / `workbuddyai.fetchV3Catalog` 四处在 `resp.StatusCode != 200` 时返回 `fmt.Errorf("models api status %d: %s", …)`。**后果链**：上层 401 自愈全靠 `errors.As` 取 `*provider.Error` 判 `Kind == ErrSessionDead`（`app.refreshIfSessionDead`、`handler.recoverSession`），裸 `fmt.Errorf` 让 `errors.As` 恒 false ⇒ **模型面与费率面的 401 自愈永远不可能生效**（不变量 19 的既有缺口）。触发条件比想象的窄但真实存在：`fetchRuntimeModels`/`RefreshPricing` 都有「`NeedsRefresh(10min)` 先 refresh」的前置检查，故只有「本地 `expiresAt` 仍在未来、上游已拒绝」的边界（token 在别处被轮换 / 上游临时吊销会话）才会踩到；一旦踩到，模型列表与费率面板会**一直陈旧**直到进程重启或 token 自然过期，日志里只有一行不带分类的 `models fetch failed`。**修法**：四处统一改返回 `&Error{Kind: Classify(status, body), Status: status, Msg: …}`（国际版对应 `&provider.Error{…}`），文案前缀从 `models api status 401:` 改为 `models api: …`（分类已由 `Kind` 字段承载，不再把状态码塞进文案）。**边界**：只改错误类型，不改任何成功路径与重试语义；`Classify` 本身零改动（401 归 `ErrSessionDead` 由 R76 保证，含网关 HTML 形态）。**回归**：`internal/upstream/typederror_test.go`（四条路径 × 401/500 分类 + 网关 HTML 401 归 session_dead）、`internal/workbuddyai/typederror_test.go`（两条 catalog 路径；**用例必须先清包级 `cache`**——`fetchCatalog` 有 10min TTL 缓存，其它用例填满后本用例连请求都不会发出，会恒「成功」而测不到任何东西，此坑已踩）。**与 R78 的关系**：R78（网关 HTML 401 识别 + 对话路径先 refresh 再标记 + 失败文案）经复核**大部分与 R76 重叠**，已整体回滚，仅保留本条（当时编号 C 的那一项）。 |
| R80 | **折线图的 0 值必须画成 null（断点），且不画「区间总量为 0」的系列**（2026-10-18，用户实测：图上底部总有一条贴底长线） | **现象**：Token 用量图底部恒有一条贯穿全图的线。**根因有两层**：① `renderUsageChart` 用「所有出现过渠道的并集」建系列，而某些渠道只在极少数时间点有量（实测 `traecode`/`qwenwork` 全天仅 10:00 一个点有值）⇒ 一条线全程只有 1 个真实点；② 更普遍的是**把 0 画成 0**：`data: byDay.map(d => d.by_channel[ch] || 0)` 让每个「该渠道没跑」的时刻都落一个 0 点，ECharts 用直线把这些 0 串起来 ⇒ 图上恒有一条贴 X 轴的长线（`workbuddy` 全天仅 21 token，视觉效果同上）。**修法**：① 按「区间总量 > 0」过滤系列（连图例都不出现）；② **0 值画成 `null`**（`return v > 0 ? v : null`）——该时刻不产生点，曲线只覆盖真正有量的时段，中间自然断开；③ 显式 `connectNulls: false`（否则 null 会被跨过连成假线）；`renderCreditChart` 同款三处。**语义依据**：这里的 0 表示「该时段没观测到用量」，不是「观测到用量为 0」，画成 0 是错误陈述；这也是 ECharts 表达「缺失数据」的标准做法。**边界**：只影响「是否画点/画线」，不影响任何数值聚合（汇总卡、模型表、流水表仍读原始数据）；某渠道一旦区间内有量就仍会出现，不因中间时段为 0 而被剔除。**回归**：`scripts/ui-static-check.mjs` 场景 4（8 条断言：active 过滤、series/color 用 active、0→null、connectNulls:false、不再用 `|| 0`，token 图与积分图各一组），已做两次反向验证——把 `active` 改回 `chans` 失败 2 项，把 `null` 改回 `|| 0` 失败 2 项。 |

| R94 | **模型降级链 = 模型维度的替换机制：三维归因（账号/模型/请求）对应四类处置（`request` / `account-transparent` / `account-rotate` / `model`），同维替换、跨维禁止；且模型饱和（14003「Model busy」/6004「usage exceeds frequency limit」）与积分耗尽（14018）同属「值得请求内重入换模型」**（2026-10-18，PR #159，全文见 [`docs/模型降级链定义.md`](模型降级链定义.md)） | **背景**：R75 只把 14018（积分耗尽）纳入请求内重入，而 14003/6004 被 `Classify` 归 `ErrSoftRate` ⇒ 只冷「账号×模型」60s，**模型饱和时的第一个请求必然把 429 抛给客户端**，第二个请求才由入口降级链顶上（生产实录 2026-10-17 20:46:00 吃 429 / 20:46:01 降级成功，同分钟后续 8 个请求全绿——差的正是这一秒）。上游自己也在文案里明示「switch models」（14003）/「switch to the other models」（6004）。**修法**：① `fallbackWorthy(kind)` 从只认 `ErrHardCredit` 扩到 `ErrHardCredit || ErrSoftRate`（请求内重入触发面扩大）；② `pickModelFallback` 增 `skipSameChannel` 入参——**请求内重入传 `true`（只跨渠道）**，入口降级传 `false`（允许同渠道）；③ 轮转内换号成功时复位 `statRow.Status`（修「A 号 429、B 号成功却记成 429」的统计失真）。**为什么请求内不许换同渠道**：换号都已失败说明这批号对该模型集体不行，而同渠道兄弟模型走的是**同一批账号**——若 429 其实是账号级限流（traework/qwenwork/qodercn/qodercom 把任意 429 都归 `ErrSoftRate`），换个兄弟模型打过去必然二次撞墙；更糟的是该账号第二个模型也撞墙后 `pool` 会把**模型级冷却升级为账号级冷却**（`until` 不延长，变的是粒度：可用容量从 1 个格子变 0）。入口降级允许同渠道的理由是信息完备度不同：那里「该模型在本渠道已全冷」是既有事实，配额按模型计，兄弟模型是另一个格子。**三维→四类处置**（以代码实际行为为准，不以注释文字为准）：`request`（不换号不冷却不换模型）/ `account-transparent`（冷却但不换号：`ErrWafBlock`、`ErrModelBlocked` 走 `Cooldown` + 原样透传）/ `account-rotate`（换号 + 冷却）/ `model`（换号 + 模型级冷却 + 换模型）。**刻意接受的两义性**：`ErrSoftRate` 一个值代表「账号被限」与「模型满」两种含义——不需分清，因为「先换号、耗尽才换模型」的成本递进顺序把二义性消化掉了。**边界**：一次请求最多降级一次（`fbAttempt==0` 硬关卡，不递归 A→B→C）；不改请求内容只改 `model` 字段；不粘滞（R54）；单账号渠道（oczen/kilo）不参与请求内重入（惩罚豁免不变量 22）；流式已写出的请求无法降级；未配置规则时零开销（`len(rules)==0` 直接返回）。**已知限制**：账号级 429 也会触发换模型（可能多烧一份备胎额度，用户裁决接受）；生产端到端未自然复现 14003 窗口，行为由单测锁定（下次真实饱和时看 `app.log` 同一请求的 `model fallback platform=` 行即自证）。**回归**：`internal/server/model_fallback_softrate_test.go`（10 例）+ `internal/server/fallback_dimension_test.go`（遍历 14 类 `ErrKind` 断言四类处置唯一性——以后新增错误类型却忘了归类，测试直接红；PR 作者自述「一开始按三维写表、被这条测试抓红后才知道 `ErrWafBlock`/`ErrModelBlocked` 实际不换号」）。 |

 # Your patch layer for this dsh profile, applied after every bundle layer:
# a top-level YAML array of loader patch entries (id-targeted config
# overrides, disables, and insert lists; `!!js` expressions allowed).
- id: ui-settings-account
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-account"
  config:
    version: 1
    step: done
    purpose: both
    process: detailed
    completion: completed
    usage: detailed
    developerTools: true
- id: ui-chat
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-chat"
  config:
    transcriptView: detailed
    performanceUsage: detailed
    linkOpening: new-tab
- id: ui-settings
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings"
  config:
    enabled: true
- id: tool-gate-bundle-row
  name: dsh-tool-gate
  config:
    deferMcpPrefixes:
      - match: mcp__
        mode: hidden
    deferNames:
      - match: workflow
        mode: hidden
      - match: plugin_manager
        mode: hidden
      - match: replay_trajectory
        mode: hidden
      - match: start_recording
        mode: hidden
      - match: stop_recording
        mode: hidden
    deferPatterns:
      - match: ^cordis_
        mode: hidden
    minSchemaBytes: 0
    promptNotice: true
    enabled: true
    passthrough:
      - tool_search
      - tool_catalog
      - read
      - write
      - edit
      - bash
      - glob
      - grep
      - ask_user_question
      - todo_write
      - run_code

      bill_stats: hidden
      dsh_im_return_file: stub
      spawn_teammate: stub
      team_task_create: stub
      team_task_get: stub
      team_task_list: stub
      team_task_update: stub
      wait_agent: stub
      send_message: stub
      list_agents: stub
      interrupt_agent: stub
      advanced_search: stub
      cache_search: stub
      domain_search: stub
      free_search_test: stub
      multi_search: stub
      platform_search: stub
      research: stub
      video_search: stub
      weather: stub
      create_worktree: full
      load_workspace_dependencies: full
      plugin_manager: stub
      read_image: full
      skill: full
      compress: full
      cordis_inspect_list: stub
      cordis_inspect_query: stub
      render_ui: full
      validate_dsh_ui: full
      rw_append: hidden
      rw_connect: hidden
      rw_deploy_probe: hidden
      rw_disconnect: hidden
      rw_download: hidden

13: // The picture grade, the same sums as pictureGradeApply in xr_grade.c, shared
14: // by the warp and the frame colour sample so the glow and the room's light
15: // follow the graded picture. u_grade is the offset, the contrast gain, the
16: // exponent (one over the gamma) and the saturation. Each shader only calls it
17: // behind u_gradeOn, a branch on a uniform, so a picture left as streamed
18: // costs nothing. The video's conversion to RGB can land a little under black
19: // or over white, which the screen shows as black or white, so that is what
20: // gets graded: lifted, it would come up darker than black does.
21: #define GRADE_GLSL \
22:     "uniform float u_gradeOn;\n" \
23:     "uniform vec4 u_grade;\n" \
24:     "vec3 grade(vec3 c) {\n" \
25:     "    c = clamp(c, 0.0, 1.0);\n" \
26:     "    c = clamp((c - 0.5) * u_grade.y + 0.5 + u_grade.x, 0.0, 1.0);\n" \
27:     "    c = pow(c, vec3(u_grade.z));\n" \
28:     "    float l = dot(c, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n" \
29:     "    return clamp(mix(vec3(l), c, u_grade.w), 0.0, 1.0);\n" \
30:     "}\n"

372: // colour of the lit texels near it along the ring, weighted by how lit they
373: // are and falling smoothly with distance, at as much brightness as the nearest
374: // of them carries that far. A lit run then ramps down into a dark one instead
375: // of stopping at its boundary, and a long dark run still ends in black. Lit
376: // texels are left as the normalisation made them.
377: //
378: // The same sums as xr_glow.c, with its constants handed in as uniforms.
379: const char* const GLOW_EDGE_FRAGMENT_SRC =
380:     "#version 300 es\n"
381:     "precision highp float;\n"
382:     "uniform sampler2D u_texture;\n"
383:     // The luma target, floor and top of the knee, then where lit starts and
384:     // ends, then the reach along the ring in texels and the inward steps
385:     "uniform vec3 u_luma;\n"
386:     "uniform vec2 u_lit;\n"
387:     "uniform float u_reach;\n"
388:     "uniform int u_steps;\n"
389:     "out vec4 fragColor;\n"
390:     // 32 is AMBI_SAMPLE_TEX, kept in step by hand. The ring runs round it
391:     // anticlockwise from the bottom left corner, 31 texels a side.
392:     "const int N = 32;\n"
393:     "const int RING = 4 * (N - 1);\n"
394:     "vec3 lifted(ivec2 p) {\n"
395:     "    vec3 c = texelFetch(u_texture, p, 0).rgb;\n"
396:     "    float l = dot(c, vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722));\n"
397:     "    float s = smoothstep(u_luma.y, u_luma.z, l);\n"
398:     "    return clamp(c * (mix(l, u_luma.x, s) / max(l, 1e-5)), 0.0, 1.0);\n"
399:     "}\n"
400:     "float lit(vec3 c) {\n"
401:     "    return smoothstep(u_lit.x, u_lit.y, max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));\n"
402:     "}\n"
403:     "ivec2 ringTexel(int i) {\n"
404:     "    if (i < N - 1) return ivec2(i, 0);\n"
405:     "    if (i < 2 * (N - 1)) return ivec2(N - 1, i - (N - 1));\n"
406:     "    if (i < 3 * (N - 1)) return ivec2(3 * (N - 1) - i, N - 1);\n"
407:     "    return ivec2(0, RING - i);\n"
408:     "}\n"
409:     "int ringIndex(ivec2 p) {\n"
410:     "    if (p.y == 0) return p.x;\n"
411:     "    if (p.x == N - 1) return (N - 1) + p.y;\n"
412:     "    if (p.y == N - 1) return 3 * (N - 1) - p.x;\n"
413:     "    return RING - p.y;\n"
414:     "}\n"
415:     // The texel's colour, or where it is dark the first lit one further in.
416:     // Whole texels, since a fetch between a dark one and a lit one reads as
417:     // lit at half the brightness. Corners look in along the diagonal.
418:     "vec3 edgeColour(int i) {\n"
419:     "    ivec2 p = ringTexel(i);\n"
420:     "    ivec2 inward = ivec2(p.x == 0 ? 1 : (p.x == N - 1 ? -1 : 0),\n"
421:     "                         p.y == 0 ? 1 : (p.y == N - 1 ? -1 : 0));\n"
422:     "    vec3 c = lifted(p);\n"
423:     "    for (int s = 1; s <= u_steps; s++) {\n"
424:     "        vec3 deeper = lifted(p + inward * s);\n"
425:     "        c = mix(deeper, c, lit(c));\n"
426:     "    }\n"
427:     "    return c;\n"
428:     "}\n"
429:     "void main() {\n"
430:     "    ivec2 p = ivec2(gl_FragCoord.xy);\n"
431:     "    if (p.x > 0 && p.y > 0 && p.x < N - 1 && p.y < N - 1) {\n"
432:     "        fragColor = vec4(lifted(p), 1.0);\n"
433:     "        return;\n"
434:     "    }\n"
435:     "    int j = ringIndex(p);\n"
436:     "    int r = min(int(u_reach), RING / 2 - 1);\n"
437:     "    vec3 own = vec3(0.0);\n"
438:     "    vec3 sum = vec3(0.0);\n"
439:     "    float weight = 0.0;\n"
440:     "    float carried = 0.0;\n"
441:     "    for (int k = -r; k <= r; k++) {\n"
442:     "        vec3 c = edgeColour((j + k + RING) % RING);\n"
443:     "        float t = float(k) / u_reach;\n"
444:     "        float w = (1.0 - t * t) * lit(c);\n"
445:     "        sum += c * w;\n"
446:     "        weight += w;\n"
447:     "        carried = max(carried, w);\n"
448:     "        if (k == 0) {\n"
449:     "            own = c;\n"
450:     "        }\n"
451:     "    }\n"
452:     "    vec3 nearby = sum / max(weight, 1e-4);\n"
453:     "    vec3 c = own + nearby * (carried * (1.0 - lit(own)));\n"
454:     "    fragColor = vec4(clamp(c, 0.0, 1.0), 1.0);\n"
455:     "}\n";
456: 
457: // The glow itself. The quad is larger than the screen, so the middle of it
458: // covers the picture and only the border is ever seen. Sampling the colour
459: // texture over that middle and letting the clamp carry the edge texels outward
460: // is what spreads the frame's colours into the space around it.

| R118 | **小浣熊（raccoon）「等响应头」的上限 60s→180s（硬下限），`upstream.timeout_seconds` 只放大不压低**（2026-10-21，用户实测驱动） | **现象**：pi 打 `raccoon/sn-kimi-k3` 间歇性整轮失败，客户端显示 `Error: 502: {"code":"upstream_error","message":"Post \"https://xiaohuanxiong.com/api/web/llm/v2/chat/completions\": net/http: timeout awaiting response headers","type":"api_error"}`；同一会话相邻几轮又正常，表现为「随机偶发」。**取证**：① `data/app.log` 该渠道累计 **235 次**同一错误，每次距 `sticky route` 精确 **60.0s**（例：`15:44:04.66` 派发 → `15:45:04.67` 报错），而 handler 按 R109 把传输层错误判为「不换号、不计账号错误」直接 502 ⇒ 换号/重试都救不回来；② 用本机账号直连上游单发实测（`max_tokens:64` 的极短请求 + `stream:true`）TTFB 三次为 **64.9s / 102.9s / 95.0s**，总耗时 101.5s / >200s / 172.0s —— 上游是**缓冲式网关**：即便请求带 `stream:true`，它也要等深度思考跑到一定阶段才回首字节；③ 所以 60s 不是「偶发抖动」而是**落在上游常态区间内**的阈值，成功那几轮只是恰好 <60s。**根因**：`internal/raccoon/client.go` 的 `newTransport()` 把 `ResponseHeaderTimeout` 写死 60s（流式 client 无总超时，这是唯一兜底），而本渠道刻意「剥离档位、走上游默认最深思考」，首字节天然比其它渠道慢一个量级。**修法**：① 新增 `defaultHeaderTimeout` / `minHeaderTimeout = 180s`，等响应头上限 = `max(minHeaderTimeout, timeout)`；② `New()` 改用下限配置，另留注入路径 `NewWithTimeout(timeout)`，`main.go` 的 `rcUp` 改走它（原先「先 `raccoon.New()` 再回手改 `HTTP.Timeout`」根本影响不到 Transport 里的响应头上限）；③ **流中空闲看门狗维持 90s 不跟着放宽**——拿到响应头之后彻底卡死，多等只是让用户多等（与 R58/R110 同口径）；④ `StreamHTTP` 仍不设总超时（R35 不变量）。**为什么用 `max` 而不是直接读配置**：`upstream.timeout_seconds`（本机 120s）是为**整条请求**设的，拿它去压「等响应头」这一段，会把 100s+ 的长思考首字节重新打成必然失败 —— 这一段只允许放宽。**边界**：非流式 `HTTP.Timeout` 仍取 `upstream.timeout_seconds`（本机 120s，对比缓冲网关 170~200s 的总耗时偏紧，但那是用户可调的既有旋钮，本条不动）；`Aggregate`（非流式）路径同受此限，需要更长就调大 `timeout_seconds`。**回归**：`internal/raccoon/timeout_test.go`（默认/注入 120s/注入 30s 均不得低于 180s、注入 600s 跟随放宽、`StreamHTTP.Timeout` 恒 0、600ms 迟回首字节端到端仍 200）；**变异验证**：两个常量改回 60s，`TestHeaderTimeoutAtLeast180s` 当场变红。`go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...` 全绿（47 包）。**已知限制**：① 180s 仍是常量（按 R58/R110 口径不新增用户概念），要再调就改 `defaultHeaderTimeout`；② 上游首字节常态已到 95~103s，若某天排队加剧越过 180s 仍会 502 —— 那种情况该做的是「等待期间给客户端保活/进度帧」，而不是继续加长超时。 |

# Provider and plugin ownership

Some built-in subscriptions are deprecated and have community plugins that provide the same service. A subscription can still use its built-in implementation or move to its plugin. That ownership determines where sign-in, refresh, model discovery, requests, usage, and errors are handled.

## Responsibilities and sources of truth

| Part | Responsibility | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Provider migration | Match subscriptions to plugins, record ownership, transfer accounts, and maintain required plugin versions | [`migrate.go`](../../internal/provider/migrate.go) and `migrate_*.go` in the same directory |
| Provider integration | Expose plugin-backed provider cards, usage, sign-in, and the plugin's own daily check-in | [`plugins.go`](../../internal/provider/plugins.go), [`plugin_usage.go`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage.go), [`pluginsignin.go`](../../internal/provider/pluginsignin.go), [`plugin_checkin.go`](../../internal/provider/plugin_checkin.go) |
| Plugin host | Load plugins and execute their code | [`internal/plugin`](../../internal/plugin), [`host.js`](../../internal/plugin/host.js) |
| Gateway | Dispatch requests through the implementation that owns the subscription | [`internal/gateway`](../../internal/gateway) |
| GUI | Present available subscriptions, migration state, and plugin sign-in | [`app.js`](../../internal/gui/assets/app.js) |
| Community plugin | Implement the moved subscription's upstream behavior | [magpie-community/plugins](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins), `packages/<name>` |

The `movers` map assembled in `internal/provider/migrate*.go` is the authoritative subscription-to-plugin mapping. Each mover's `min` is the minimum plugin version required by magpie. The list of moved subscriptions in [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md#built-in-subscriptions-that-a-plugin-serves) is a contributor lookup; confirm the mapping in source when changing it.

## Ownership and runtime paths

`provider.Moved(id)` identifies a subscription whose migration state in `migrations.json` is `plugin`. In `/api/providers`, its row exposes `move.state == "plugin"`; the GUI also receives its id in `onPlugins`.

A retired built-in (`retiredBuiltins` in [`migrate.go`](../../internal/provider/migrate.go), `provider.BuiltinRetired(id)`) has no built-in code left: the plugin serves it whether or not a move has run, and its row's `move.state` is `plugin`. Gates that once asked `Moved(id)` ask `provider.PluginServes(id)`, which is moved or retired. Built-in accounts of a retired subscription that haven't moved yet are served by nothing; `/api/providers` lists them in `unmoved` (each a `MoveCandidate`, with the failed move's `error` and `why`), and the GUI shows a line over the Providers list with a Move button (`unmovedLine` in `app.js`). Built-ins are retired one at a time, each in the commit that removes its code. Antigravity is the exception (11-15): retired before its code is removed, it is kept from Google by `googleLogins`, which lists no account of a subscription its plugin serves (the mover reads `googleSavedLogins`), and its plugin is withdrawn for anyone new: `plugin.Add` refuses a withdrawn package this magpie doesn't have listed (`withdrawn` in [`withdrawn.go`](../../internal/plugin/withdrawn.go), `RefuseWithdrawn`), the mover installs it for the user's own accounts under `plugin.KeepWithdrawn`, and `/api/providers` lists the ones kept in `withdrawn`, which the GUI shows as a line over the Providers list pointing to Antigravity (local agy CLI).

| Operation | Built-in owns the subscription | Plugin owns the subscription |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Sign-in, refresh, and models | Built-in provider implementation | Community plugin through magpie's plugin integration |
| Upstream requests and translation | Built-in gateway adapter | Plugin fetch through the plugin host |
| Usage and upstream errors | Built-in implementation | Plugin, exposed through magpie's provider integration |
| Migration state and required version | Magpie | Magpie |

For a moved subscription, its built-in upstream implementation does not run. Plugin accounts use `Account.Agent == "plugin"`; requests reach `plugin.Fetch` through `Provider.Do` and bypass the built-in subscription adapter. Magpie still handles routing, protocol conversion, quota handling, and compatibility adjustments, as well as the plugin host, provider integration, migration code, and GUI plugin paths.

Quota aggregation in [`quotas.go`](../../internal/provider/quotas.go) suppresses a key's GLM Coding Plan card only when its comparable reset windows match a ZCode subscription card: built-in or moved `zcode`, or independently installed `zcode-plugin`. [`PlanQuotas`](../../internal/provider/planquota.go) identifies GLM plans by their quota endpoint, including custom provider ids. Matching reset schedules from unrelated vendors do not hide cards. Within this pair, resets remain a heuristic for the shared account; a plan's `User` is a key label or mask, not a login identity. Errors, conflicting resets, or no comparable resets keep the plan visible. This applies to the Usage page, tray, quota reports, alerts, and quota waits; it does not change plugin ownership or upstream requests.

## Usage a plugin collects late

A plugin that learns a step's usage only after the step has ended reports it with a later step, in `usage.magpie_deferred` (`prompt_tokens`, `completion_tokens`, `cached_tokens`, `cache_write_tokens`) beside that step's own usage fields. The Cursor plugin does this: a tool step's usage event shows seconds after the step, so the step says 0 and the conversation's next step collects the event ([#1053](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/1053)).

The gateway parses the field into `Usage.Deferred` ([`cUsage`](../../internal/gateway/chat.go)) and adds it only where it bills: the usage records, the OTel attempt spans and route pricing, which prices it as a tier before the request's own ([`routeUsage`](../../internal/gateway/trace.go), [`Usage.billed`](../../internal/gateway/ir.go)). What a client is told stays the request's own, because agents read `prompt_tokens` as how full their context is: the passthrough forwards the plugin's bytes as they are, whose standard fields are the step's own, and a translated reply is encoded from the own count alone. `promptCounted` also reads the request's own. A reply without the field is handled as before. With an older magpie the field is ignored and the owed step goes unbilled in the ledger. [`deferred_usage_test.go`](../../internal/gateway/deferred_usage_test.go) covers the passthrough, the translated reply, the ledger, the OTel span and the pricing tiers.

## A usage window that says no share

A usage window's `used` (percent) may be left out when the plugin can't tell it: the Loomy plugins send only `display` ([#3650](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3650)). Left out is not 0. The host passes it on as `null` (`usageOf` in [`host.js`](../../internal/plugin/host.js)), `plugin.UsageWindow.Used` is a `*float64`, and [`quotaOfPlugin`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage.go) makes such a window `Text` and `Aside`: the card shows its `display` (else "No allowance reported"), never a percentage or a meter (`quotaNoShare` in `app.js`), and `allowanceOf` leaves it out. An account whose windows all tell no share has no allowance, so routing counts it not known (`routedAllowance` in [`routing.go`](../../internal/provider/routing.go), for a fresh reading and the one kept on disk alike), as one never read, rather than as the one with all of it left. A window that says `used: 0` is a reading at 0, as before. [`plugin_usage_absent_test.go`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage_absent_test.go) and `usage-no-reading.test.cjs` cover both.

A window that leaves out `used` but tells its count, `amount` of `limit` with both above 0, has the count's share (370 of 1000 is 37 used): [`quotaOfPlugin`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage.go) fills `Used` from it, so the window is neither `Text` nor, unless the plugin set it, `Aside`, and routing reads it ([magpie-community/plugins#468](https://github.com/magpie-community/plugins/issues/468)). Before, such a window was text alone, and an account whose windows all told counts so was unknown to routing. An `amount` of 0 is what a left-out amount reads as, so a `limit` alone still says nothing. `aside: true` keeps a window out of routing (`allowanceOf`) whatever its count; the card and `/v1/magpie/quotas` still show it. `TestAWindowsCountIsItsShare` in [`plugin_usage_absent_test.go`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage_absent_test.go) covers it.

## A wallet's balance

A prepaid wallet (SuperMagic's points, [#3950](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3950)) has a balance and nothing it is a share of. A usage window may send `balance` (a number, in `unit`) and leave out `used`, `limit` and `aside`: `{name: "积分", balance: 6291, unit: "积分"}`. The host passes a finite number on, at least 0, and anything else as `null` (`usageOf` in [`host.js`](../../internal/plugin/host.js)); `plugin.UsageWindow.Balance` and `provider.QuotaWindow.Balance` are `*float64`. [`quotaOfPlugin`](../../internal/provider/plugin_usage.go) keeps the figure and does not make the window `Text` or `Aside`, so the account is known to routing with no `Used` invented. `allowanceOf` copies it into `Limit.Balance`, and an empty wallet (0) counts as used up. `Allowance.Left(model)` is the least balance of the windows that count the model, with its unit. `weighRouted` sets `routes.Seat.Left` to it and `Seat.LeftIn` to the account's provider and unit; Smart, `pace` and `usage` put the seat with more left first where they would otherwise tie (`byLeft` in [`strategies.go`](../../internal/routes/strategies.go)), and only among seats that share one `LeftIn`, so balances in two units or two providers are never weighed against each other: each kind is put in the places its own seats take (the pool's order, or what magpie sent each lately for `pace` and `usage`), and the other kinds keep theirs. Before, a pool with two kinds was weighed by no balance, so a group of SuperMagic's and WorkBuddy's accounts spent SuperMagic's smallest balances first (#4095). The card, the Routing page (`Weighed.Balance`) and the CLI show the figure ("6,291 积分 left", `provider.BalanceText`) and no meter. ## Cache a vendor doesn't count

A plugin whose vendor counts no cache tokens says so with `usage.magpie_cache_unknown: true` in its Anthropic usage, and leaves the cache fields out. Kiro does this: it caches on its side (a repeated prompt costs about half the credits), but its replies carry credits and a context share, never tokens (opencode-kiro-auth 0.1.16, zeewell on X). The gateway reads the field in [`aUsage`](../../internal/gateway/anthropic.go) into `Usage.cacheUnknown`, ORed across a reply's usage events. [`routeUsage`](../../internal/gateway/trace.go) then sets `RouteUsage.CacheUnknown` on a try that counted no cache read or write. The Routing page's `promptOf` (`plugins/routing/client.js`) leaves such a try out of the hit rate, so the request shows none, not 0%. The field is never told to a client: `Usage.anthropic()` leaves it out, and a passthrough forwards the plugin's bytes as they are. The usage ledger carries it too ([#3464](https://github.com/yetone/magpie/issues/3464)): the gateway records `usage.Record.CacheUnknown` on a call that counted no cache (`Usage.cacheNotCounted`), the ledger keeps it as row flag 8192 (`rowCacheUnknown`), and `usage.Totals` sums such calls' prompt into `cache_unknown` and their count into `cache_unknown_calls`. Every hit rate leaves that prompt out of its denominator: `Totals.HitRate`, and `cacheHitOf` in app.js, used by the tray panel's card, the Usage page's agent rows and cache tile, the requests' Cache hit rate card (which says how many it left out, `cacheLeftOut`) and each ranking row. One of only such calls shows no rate. A request row's cache cells show "—" and its details say the vendor doesn't count the cache. Calls kept before Kiro's plugin said so carry no flag, so a Kiro call (`kiro` or `kiro-plugin`) with no cache counted is read as one (`usage.CountsNoCache`): in the ledger's `rowChunk.row`, in `Totals.countCache`, and for Routing's history in `pricedRoutes` (`cacheCounted`, `internal/gui/trace.go`). The context view (`internal/gui/context.go`, `context.js`) shows no cache for such a call and doesn't score it as a miss. Not covered: hit rates read from agents' own session files (`sessions.Tokens`: the TUI and CLI session lists, the Sessions tab's totals), which carry Kiro's 0 as a miss. [`cache_unknown_test.go`](../../internal/gateway/cache_unknown_test.go) covers the passthrough and translated replies, both whole and streamed.

## A plugin's daily check-in

A plugin can press its vendor's daily check-in (签到) itself: its `auth` hook gains `checkin(getAuth, provider)`, beside `usage`. The host lists the provider with `checkin: true` (`plugin.Provider.Checkin`) and answers `checkin({provider, account})` (`plugin.AccountCheckin`) by refreshing the account as `usage` does and calling the hook with the account's auth.

The hook returns `{outcome, credit?, streak?, message?, until?}`. `outcome` is one of `claimed` (checked in now), `done` (already in today), `ineligible`, `inactive` (no check-in event now), `captcha` or `failed`. A throw, or an outcome not in that list, is `failed` with the reason; for an outcome not in the list the reason names what the plugin answered, before its own message (`the plugin answered "yes": …`), so a plugin's wording isn't read as magpie's. `captcha` means the vendor wants a captcha: magpie never solves one, and says "check in in its own app" instead. A plugin must not solve captchas either. An `inactive` or `ineligible` result with a `message` shows it beside the fixed label ("No check-in event now · <message>") on the card, where it wraps rather than ends in "…", in Settings' check-in line and in `magpie accounts checkin`; the TUI's narrow cell says `c` says why, and `c`'s flash carries it (plugins#304). Without a message the label reads alone.

[`plugin_checkin.go`](../../internal/provider/plugin_checkin.go) runs these through the same `checkiner` as the built-in check-ins ([`checkin.go`](../../internal/provider/checkin.go)): each signed-in, in-use account once a Beijing day, the first look 2 minutes after start and then every 30 minutes, the day's first ask from the time of day the user set (`settings.CheckinAt`, one for every vendor, built-in and plugin; the first such time on the computer's clock at or after the Beijing day's start, `checkinGate`, so every Beijing day holds one; none set asks as the day turns, as before; times_ang on X) while an answer for that day, its `until` and its retries go on as below, a `failed` asked again after 30 minutes, or at its `until` when that is later (`heldUntil`: a rate-limited claim read, plugins#793), at most 24 hours on and across the Beijing day's turn, a press still asking at once, every other outcome settled for the day. A `done`, `inactive` or `ineligible` answered before noon Beijing (`checkinSureHour`) for an account magpie hasn't seen claim that Beijing day is provisional (`provisional`, #3326): a vendor whose day turns at UTC midnight (08:00 Beijing) or later still answers yesterday's "already" at 00:00, and magpie took it for today's and never asked again. The loop asks it again 30 minutes after the answer, until a claim or an answer from noon on, so at most 24 more asks a day and none once magpie claims; a press (`soon`) asks it again at once, whatever the hour, since the vendor's answer is what the press is for. A claim stamps `Claimed`, carried over while later answers that day say done, so a done after magpie's own claim is settled. Such a record is sent with `again: true` (`shown`, never kept), and the card, Settings, TUI and CLI say the vendor said already checked in and magpie asks again later, not "Checked in today", and the card keeps *Check in now*. A vendor whose day turns after noon Beijing (a US day) is not covered. The Qoder, Qoder CN and ZCode plugins are the exception, as magpie's own Qoder check-in is (`recheck`, `pluginRechecks`, #2696, plugins#503): a campaign or gift plan can open mid-day (Qoder CN's ran 10:00 to 09:59 the next day), so the loop asks again 30 minutes after the last answer, whatever it was but a `captcha` or `own-app`, which waits on the user in the vendor's app and stands for the day (asked again, ZCode's claim only answered 3007 again, plugins#503), and *Check in now* asks at once, and their card keeps *Check in now* for an `inactive` result. Every other plugin keeps the day's result. A plugin whose vendor's day turns at another hour says when in `until` (an RFC 3339 time or epoch milliseconds; `host.js` passes it on as RFC 3339, `plugin.Checkin.Until`), kept as the record's `ValidUntil`: the answer is settled only until then, whatever its outcome (`settled`), the loop wakes then rather than at its next 30-minute look (`wbCheckinLoop.tick`), and an early `done` that says it isn't provisional, since the vendor said when its day turns. Qoder's daily credits open at 10:00 UTC+8 and close at 09:59 the next day (its `/me/campaigns` `startAt`/`endAt`); the Qoder plugins from 0.2.43 answer `until` a minute past the next opening, so a check-in before 10:00, which claims or meets the day before's campaign, is asked again at 10:01, not up to half an hour later (sdytman on Discord). Times are compared as instants, so the machine's zone doesn't matter. Results are kept in `plugin-checkin.json` by `provider|<sign-in key>` (`pluginCheckinKey`: the key `plugin-auth.json` keeps the sign-in under, `autoclaw` or `autoclaw#x1y2z3`), never by the display name: two sign-ins can share a name (AutoClaw's default can't be changed), and keyed by it only the first of them was ever checked in, by the loop or *Check in now* (plugins#254). The sign-in key holds over a refresh and over signing in to the same account again (`settle` in `host.js` puts it back under its key); a sign-in made after one was signed out the same day may take the freed key, and with it that day's result. An entry kept by `provider|<display name>` before then is carried over once the plugin's accounts are listed (`adoptLegacyPluginCheckins`): a check-in goes to the first sign-in in use of that name, the one the old key asked, and only to it, so its namesakes are asked and none twice; an `Off` in `settings.CheckinOff` goes to every sign-in of that name, since none of them was checked in while it was off. A `plugin-checkin.json` that can't be read or parsed is left as it is and carried over once it reads; until then no plugin account is checked in, and each says why (`readCheckins`, as for every vendor's check-in file). A failure is recorded as failed and never resets an account, a key or a previous day's result. Each account's Usage card has the check-in row (`checkinBy: "plugin:<provider>"`), and Settings → Usage has a Plugins tab with a Daily check-in switch per provider (`settings.PluginCheckins`, `POST /api/settings/plugin-checkin {provider, on}`; *Check in now* is `POST /api/usage/plugin-checkin {provider}`). The press says what it came to, a count per kind (`checkinPressSaid`, #3326): claimed now with the credits, already checked in today, not available yet (`inactive`, `ineligible`, or an `again` answer), to check in in the vendor's own app, failed; a result is claimed now only when it carries `asked` (`Asked`, sent but never kept), so an account claimed earlier today counts as already. `magpie accounts checkin` and `c` on the TUI's Usage page include them. Every check-in, built-in or a plugin's, also skips an account listed in `settings.CheckinOff` by its file key (#1902): `checkinNow` asks nothing for it, by the loop or a press, `CheckinAccounts()` lists each account with its own `on` for Settings (`checkinAccounts`, a row each under the vendor's switch when it has two or more, `POST /api/settings/checkin-account {key, on}`), and its card carries `checkinOff`. Under each vendor's switch in Settings, a *Check in now* row checks one account in once (`checkinNowRow`, drawn by [`checkinnow.js`](../../internal/gui/assets/checkinnow.js), loaded when Settings draws a vendor's check-in so it weighs nothing on the core; `POST /api/usage/checkin-account {by, key}`, `provider.CheckInAccount`; xiaowu_95660 on Discord): the same `checkinNow` press, with `only` set to that account's key, so no other account is asked or reported, and the account is asked even while its switch is off, which the press leaves as it is. With two or more accounts the button opens the app menu to pick one. The row says what came of it: checked in with the credit and streak, already checked in today, not eligible or no check-in event with the vendor's message, check in in the vendor's own app, or the failure. It reads the Usage cards again but doesn't draw Settings again under the button.

The switch is off by default. For a provider whose vendor magpie checked in through the plugin's fetch before (WorkBuddy, Trae CN, MiniMax Code, Qoder), it follows that vendor's existing switch until set on its own, and magpie's own check-in leaves that provider's accounts to the plugin (`pluginChecksIn`), so an account is never checked in twice.

A provider switched off (`Off`, not `Hidden`) has no Usage card and the loop leaves it alone (`leftAlone`), but its accounts can still be checked in by hand (wxkwxk666 on X). `GET /api/usage/checkins/off` lists them (`provider.OffCheckins` in [`off_checkins.go`](../../internal/provider/off_checkins.go)): one card per account a checkiner reaches, with no windows, nothing read or asked, its check-in marked by its own key rather than its name. The Usage page shows them in a *Switched off · n* line after the cards and the hidden line, folded until clicked (`renderQuotaOff` in `plugins/usage/page.js`), each account with what came of today's check-in and, when it isn't in, its own *Check in* (`ciNowSend` from `checkinnow.js`, `POST /api/usage/checkin-account`). *Check in all*, at the allowances' head (`checkinAll`), presses every account of the cards and of that line not checked in today (`checkinDue`, its per-account switch ignored as a press does), one `checkin-account` each, three at a time, saying how far it has got and then the counts (`checkinPressSaid`); with none due it says so and asks nothing. Neither switches a provider back on. See `TestOffCheckinsListsSwitchedOffAccounts`, `usage-checkin-all.test.cjs`.

./docs/subsystems/agent-wiring.md:155:- Avibe (`avibe.go`, `avibe-os` on PyPI, the `vibe` CLI) keeps its model sources in `model_hub.sources` of `config/config.json` in its home (`$AVIBE_HOME`, else `~/.avibe`, else a legacy `~/.vibe_remote`: `config/paths.py`). A source can't be written there by hand: its key is sealed in the Model Hub's store and Avibe adds it to its agents' route chains as it is made. The balance curve sets no `data-series` and keeps its solid line, dashed fit and dot. The Context tab's "good" grade, which takes `--c2` as a colour rather than a series, keeps a blue (`--c1`). Open at login reads `autostart.Enabled`, which on macOS 13 and later also asks Background Task Management about magpie's launch agent (`SMAppService.statusForLegacyURL:`, matched by the plist's Label, not its path); a record the user switched off in System Settings › General › Login Items reads as needing allowing, and the row keeps On with one line saying so and a button that opens Login Items (`/api/open` allows that one `x-apple.systempreferences` URL). docs/subsystems/agent-wiring.md:110:- QwenPaw keeps each agent's model in `active_model` of its workspace's `agent.json` (the agents listed in `config.json` under `$QWENPAW_WORKING_DIR`, a legacy `~/.copaw`, or `~/.qwenpaw`) and its providers as files under its secret folder (`$QWENPAW_SECRET_DIR`, also read from the working folder's `.env`, else `<working folder>.secret`) (`qwenpaw` and `qwenpawAgents` in [`qwenpaw.go`](../../internal/agent/qwenpaw.go)). magpie writes `providers/custom/magpie.json` as QwenPaw's console saves a custom provider (OpenAI Chat at the gateway's `/v1`, the key in plain text, which QwenPaw encrypts at its next start, magpie's models in `extra_models`), keeps what the user changes there (a model's `config_overrides`, headers, generation settings), and sets the agent's `active_model` to `magpie`/`<provider>/<model>`, putting back what it found there. A model with reasoning levels is declared `thinking_param_style: "effort"` with the levels QwenPaw names in `reasoning_effort_options` (no `none`: QwenPaw turns an off into Qwen's and DeepSeek's `extra_body` switches), since QwenPaw applies an agent's `thinking_level` only to a model whose card says how it thinks; the effort field is that `thinking_level` in `agent.json`, written with no `thinking_budget`, `inherit` when cleared. Each QwenPaw agent on QwenPaw's own backend is a row (`qwenpaw#<id>` beside the default's `qwenpaw`); the provider file goes when no agent's model, fallback or subagent model names it. QwenPaw reads `agent.json` again when it changes but its providers only at start-up, so the notice says to restart it after the first connect.

23:| Stopped WSL distro | A stopped distro's agents are no targets: opening their files would start the distro, or the read fails (#3896). While a distro runs, `keepShape` keeps each agent's places and what its MCP file takes in `wsl.json` (`agent.WSLKeep`, key `library:<kind>`). While it is stopped, `Read` lists its agents from that (`asleepView`, `asleep: <distro>`), ticks as library.json has them; one magpie never saw there is listed only on the rows that name it, as `unseen`, its ticks not shown (cybercaius on Discord: the MCP page knew a distro's agents only once WSL had started). A tick on a stopped agent is kept in library.json as any is (`Takes` accepts one with a known shape; `serversAgents` judges it by `shape.reaches`), nothing is written and nothing in the distro runs; `Woken`, from `KeepLinked`'s loop (and the app's start-up sync), syncs when a distro the library names is seen go from stopped to running (`wsl.exe -l --running`, which starts nothing). The page greys a stopped agent's chip, says so in its tooltip and in one line per distro (`.lib-asleep`); an unseen chip is `aria-disabled` and kept by every click on its row (`keptOf`). The CLI says the same on stderr (`AsleepIn`). Queued, not a start button: a start costs the memory #3896 is about, and All or a bulk tick would start every distro. The Instructions page lists them too (`asleepInstructions`, #4182), at the instructions file the shape keeps, switched on as library.json has them, with what each gets besides (magpie's own folder) and nothing read from the file: its own lines and edits aren't counted then, and its path is plain text, not a reveal, which would open the distro. One switched on whose file magpie never saw is listed as `unseen`, its switch greyed out and kept by every other switch; before, a switch on the page sent the agents without the stopped distro's and took them off. A switch on one is written by `Woken`, which watches a distro named in `Instructions.Agents`, or whose agent still has magpie's part (`Applied.Instructions`), so one switched off has it taken out. The Hooks page lists the stopped agents with a shape as it does while the distro runs (`hooksView`, #4237): greyed, since magpie gives no agent in WSL hooks yet (`wslNoHooks`), and a hook given one says so; there is nothing for `Woken` to write. A skill is linked (or copied) into the folder the agent reads a project's skills from (`projectSkillsDirs`): `.claude/skills` for Claude Code, `.qoder/skills` for Qoder and Qoder CN, `.codebuddy/skills` for CodeBuddy Code, `.commandcode/skills` for Command Code, and `.agents/skills` for Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Pi, Cursor, Copilot CLI, Antigravity, Kimi, Goose, Grok, Droid, Cline and DeepSeek Harness (which reads it, and `.dsh/skills`, at the nearest folder up with a `.git`, else where it runs: a project folder inside a repository but not at its root doesn't reach it, #5172). A server is written into the file the agent reads a project's servers from (`projectMCPFiles`), in the shape its user-wide file has: `.mcp.json` for Claude Code and CodeBuddy Code (CodeBuddy's `mcp.json` when the project has that and no `.mcp.json`, since it reads only the first of the two), `.codex/config.toml`, `.gemini/settings.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`, `opencode.json`, `.zcode/config.json`, `.pi/mcp.json`, `.qoder/settings.json`'s `mcpServers` for Qoder and Qoder CN, and `.factory/mcp.json` for Droid. Claude Code, Qoder and CodeBuddy ask the user to approve a project's server before using it. Only targets whose vendor source or docs name them are listed (each map's comment cites them); an agent with none (Copilot CLI's MCP, Zed, WorkBuddy, Command Code's MCP, whose `.mcp.json` has its own `transport` shape, DeepSeek Harness's MCP, whose servers are rows in its profiles' patch layers with no project layer) can't be picked for a project (eirc on Discord). `Placed`, `Wrote`, `Made` and `MadeFiles` record what magpie put there, the only things it takes away. Nothing of magpie's goes into the project's git: what it placed is listed in the repository's own `info/exclude` (`writeExclude`, one block per project between `excludeBegin(dir)` and `ignoreEnd`, read by every worktree, never committed), and the project's `.gitignore` is left as it is (a block an older magpie wrote there is taken out, `TestProjectKeptOutOfGitByExclude`). A folder outside git gets no ignore file; once it is `git init`ed, `treesChanged` sees no block and the next `KeepLinked` writes it (`TestProjectOutsideGit`). A project is the global set ± its own (WhyULose0 on X): `ServersOff` and `SkillsOff` turn a global server or skill off in the project for some agents (`ProjectServerOff`, `ProjectSkillsOff`; `POST /api/library/projects/server-off` and `skill-off` with `dir`, `name`/`names`, `agents`; none gives it back). Each is done the way the agent reads it for a folder (`project_scope.go`): Claude Code's record of the project in `~/.claude.json` (`projects[<main worktree's top>]`, `claudeRoot`) gets the name in `disabledMcpServers`, where magpie takes out only names it added (`Claude.Off`); Codex gets `[mcp_servers.<name>] enabled = false` in the project's `.codex/config.toml`, only for a server in its own config (`CodexOff`); a skill is `skillOverrides.<name> = "off"` in the project's `.claude/settings.local.json` (`Overrides`), a value the user set there is theirs (`TestProjectServerOff`, `TestProjectSkillOff`). Only those (`ProjectOffAgents`, `ProjectSkillOffAgents`) can take an off, and a skill an agent reaches through the [skill router](skill-router.md) can't; the card shows a global agent that can't as always on, with why. With the [MCP router](mcp-router.md) on, a project that adds or turns off a server the router serves gives Claude Code and Codex their own hub entry, `<agent>~<projectKey>` (`projectHubs`): Claude Code's in its record's `mcpServers` (local scope), Codex's in the project's `.codex/config.toml`; the server added isn't written into `.mcp.json` then (`TestProjectSetThroughRouter`). Claude Code keys its record by the repository's main top folder, so a project in a subfolder turns its offs on for the whole repository. A git worktree of the project's repository follows the project (`treeDirs`, `Trees`): the project's folder in each worktree gets the same skills, servers and offs, and is let go when the worktree is removed; `KeepLinked` checks for new ones (`keepProjectTrees`, `TestProjectWorktreeFollows`). 36:| Hooks | A `Hook` (#1790) is a command, an event, an optional matcher, a timeout and the agents ticked for it. Its optional `Description` (#2011) says what it is for in any language, since its name is letters, digits, - and _: one line of at most `maxHookDescription` (200) characters, shown under the name; only library.json keeps it, and no agent is given it. Its event is portable (`HookEvents`: turn-end, after-tool, before-tool, prompt, session-start, each under the agent's own name) or an agent's own (`"codex:PermissionRequest"`), which only that agent is given. A portable tool event can be narrowed to shell or edit tools, each agent's own tool names for them. A session-start hook can be narrowed to some starts (#5604, NEKO-CwC: re-inject a file after compaction alone), one or more of `HookStarts` (startup, resume, clear, compact, fork, Claude Code's words) joined by `|`; `startMatcher` writes each agent's own matcher for them. Claude Code and Codex take the starts as written (Codex reads a `|` list as exact names). Gemini CLI has startup, resume and clear only and compares its matcher whole, so it takes one of them. Grok has `new` (startup and /clear) and `load` (resume), so it takes exactly one of those groups. Cursor's sessionStart takes no matcher. Starts an agent doesn't have are dropped, and one that has all that are left is given the hook whole. An agent that can't run it at exactly the starts picked is refused with why, as for any other per-agent limit: never widened to every start, which would run it at the starts the user narrowed away (a fork per subagent), nor written with a matcher it never matches. The written matcher is in `Applied.Hooks`, so an agent's own edit of the entry is still theirs. `HookAgentView.Starts` lists the matchers each agent takes, and the editor's At which starts app menu greys the chips of those that can't. A bundle carrying a narrowed hook to a magpie before this writes it whole. `syncHooks` writes each into the agent's own file and shape (`hookSpecOf`): Claude Code `<claude dir>/settings.json`, Codex `hooks.json` beside its config.toml, Gemini CLI `~/.gemini/settings.json` (timeout in ms), Cursor `~/.cursor/hooks.json` (flat entries, `version: 1`), and Grok Build `~/.grok/config.toml` and Grok App `agent-home/config.toml` as `[[hooks.<Event>]]` array tables with a `[[hooks.<Event>.hooks]]` child. Every other agent, and an agent in WSL, is refused with why, and the page greys its chip with that reason. # HomeKit Bridge

The **HomeKit Bridge** integrationIntegrations connect and integrate Home Assistant with your devices, services, and more. [\[Learn more\]](/getting-started/concepts-terminology/#integrations) allows you to make your Home Assistant entities available in Apple HomeKit, so they can be controlled from Apple’s Home app and Siri; even if those devices do not natively support HomeKit.

Please make sure that you have read the [considerations](#considerations) listed below to save you some trouble later. However, if you do encounter issues, check out the [troubleshooting](#troubleshooting) section.

Tip

If you want to control HomeKit-only devices with Home Assistant, check out the [HomeKit Device](/integrations/homekit_controller/) integration, which provides the possibility to pull HomeKit-enabled devices into Home Assistant.

## Configuration[](#configuration)

To add the **HomeKit Bridge** integration to your Home Assistant instance, use this My button:

[![](https://my.home-assistant.io/badges/config_flow_start.svg)](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start?domain=homekit)

HomeKit Bridge can be auto-discovered by Home Assistant. If an instance was found, it will be shown as **Discovered**. You can then set it up right away.

Manual configuration steps

If it wasn’t discovered automatically, don’t worry! You can set up a manual integration entry:

-   Browse to your Home Assistant instance.
    
-   Go to **[Settings > Devices & services](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/integrations)**.
    
-   In the bottom right corner, select the **[Add Integration](https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/config_flow_start?domain=homekit)** button.
    
-   From the list, select **HomeKit Bridge**.
    
-   Follow the instructions on screen to complete the setup.
    

## Manual configuration[](#manual-configuration)

If you want to make specific changes to the way entities are published to HomeKit, override the IP address the HomeKit integration uses to communicate with your network or change the IP address the HomeKit uses to advertise itself to the network, then you will need to configure the HomeKit integration using an entry in your `configuration.yaml`The configuration.yaml file is the main configuration file for Home Assistant. It lists the integrations to be loaded and their specific configurations. In some cases, the configuration needs to be edited manually directly in the configuration.yaml file. Most integrations can be configured in the UI. [\[Learn more\]](/docs/configuration/) file.

This is an example entry of how that would look:

```
# Example configuration.yaml entry configuring HomeKit
homekit:
  - filter:
      include_domains:
        - alarm_control_panel
        - light
        - media_player
      include_entity_globs:
        - binary_sensor.*_occupancy
      include_entities:
        - binary_sensor.living_room_motion
        - valve.front_lawn
    entity_config:
      alarm_control_panel.home:
        code: 1234
      binary_sensor.living_room_motion:
        linked_battery_sensor: sensor.living_room_motion_battery
        low_battery_threshold: 31
      fan.air_purifier:
        type: air_purifier
        linked_filter_life_level_sensor: sensor.air_purifier_filter_life_level
      light.kitchen_table:
        name: Kitchen Table Light
      lock.front_door:
        code: 1234
      media_player.living_room:
        feature_list:
          - feature: on_off
          - feature: play_pause
          - feature: play_stop
          - feature: toggle_mute
      switch.bedroom_outlet:
        type: outlet
      valve.front_lawn:
        type: sprinkler
      camera.back_porch:
        support_audio: true
      sensor.some_co_sensor:
        co_threshold: 1000
      sensor.some_co2_sensor:
        co2_threshold: 1000
  - name: HASS Bridge 2
    port: 21065
    filter:
      include_domains:
        - light
```

stream source from camera entity
